title: 第10章 指点第11章 聚灵
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 他的话一出，江伯与江良神情皆是一滞，随即便是狂喜起来：“长青，你说的是真的？”
习武只是为了自保，增加一分活下去的希望，而要逆天改命，那就得修行了，只是修行条件苛刻，外加难度极高，因此外城区的居民根本不敢奢望。
而如今听到沈长青竟然去修行了，两人皆是又惊又喜。
“沈长青？”
还不等沈长青回话，院外突然传来一道带着惊讶的年轻声音，紧接着，便见江霸领着四五个汉子从外面走了进来。
方才说话的是紧紧跟在江霸身后的一名年轻人，沈长青认得此人，其是江霸之子江浩。
江浩身形壮硕，是江家堡年轻一辈中的领军人物，此刻看到沈长青，他顿时皱起眉头，一脸警惕道：“沈长青，多日不见，莫非你又在打我江氏武学的主意了？”
唰。
霎时间，江霸等人齐齐向沈长青看来，罡行拳乃江氏之根基，他们绝不容许外人染指。
“江浩，你别血口喷人。”
江良年轻气盛，看不得沈长青被人污蔑，当即站出来说道：“长青大哥现在在太虚剑观修行，哪里需要学武。”
修行？！
这些汉子每个都极其强壮，他们站在那里，宛若一堵堵墙，给人不小的压迫感。
此刻听到江良的话后，江霸顿时用冷冽的眸子扫了沈长青一眼，声音沉闷如雷：“长青去修行了？”
这也并非什么见不得人的事，沈长青神色平静，如实道：“不错。”
“能弄到灵石那是你的本事。”
江霸对这个外姓人有不小的印象，他摇头道：“但要我说，与其奢望那些虚无缥缈的东西，你还不如拿来换罡形拳，起码我可以保证你能学个几招几式，而不是像现在这样打了水漂。”
“就是，修行看要命，长青你也有那命啊。”江浩明显有些酸了，不过他倒不觉得沈长青能成，只是眼红对方竟然能搞到灵石去修行。
江霸便不再看沈长青，而是对江伯道：“老五，我不希望江氏武学外传。”
沈长青修行不成，定然还是要习武，若是对方能拿的出灵石来，倒也不是不能供其一观，但若是拿不出来，那是决计不允许外传的！
说完，他便吩咐后面的人取了个布包交给了江伯，“这是你家这个月的气血药，收好。”
做完这一切，江霸一行人便离开了。
“长青，你莫要被旁人影响，好好修炼。”江伯担心江霸等人的话会影响到沈长青的心态，于是连忙安慰。
沈长青笑了笑，并不以为意。
江良一直对内城的生活充满好奇，此时也是询问了起来：“长青大哥，内城的生活是什么样的？”
江伯也看向沈长青，想要知道他被沈家寻回后的生活变成了什么样。
沈长青也没有隐瞒，将自己和沈正峰夫妇交易乃至入赘李家的事情说了出来。
他刚说完，江良便义愤填膺道：“难怪这沈家人不允许我们向别人说你的来历与去向，原来是早有这种打算。”
沈长青默然。
江伯叹息一声，道：“我这院子虽小，但多一个人的空间还是随时能腾出来的。”
江良也冷静下来了，他拍了拍胸膛，道：“长青大哥，即便你修行不成，我也可以保护你。”
啪。
content_en:
As soon as his words came out, Jiang Bo and Jiang Liang's expressions froze, and then they became ecstatic: "Changqing, is what you said true?"
Practicing martial arts is just for self-protection and to increase the hope of survival. If you want to change your destiny against the will of heaven, you have to practice martial arts. However, the conditions for practicing martial arts are harsh and extremely difficult, so the residents of the outer city simply don't dare to hope.
But now that they heard that Shen Changqing actually went to practice, both of them were surprised and happy.
"Shen Changqing?"
Before Shen Changqing could reply, a surprised young voice suddenly came from outside the hospital, and then, Jiang Ba led four or five men in from the outside.
The person who spoke just now was a young man who was following Jiang Ba closely. Shen Changqing recognized this person. He was Jiang Hao, Jiang Ba's son.
Jiang Hao is a strong man and is the leader of the younger generation in Jiangjiabao. Seeing Shen Changqing at this moment, he frowned and said with a vigilant look on his face: "Shen Changqing, I haven't seen you for many days. Could it be that you are trying to take advantage of my Jiang family martial arts again?"
Uh-huh.
In an instant, Jiang Ba and others all looked to Shen Changqing that Gangxing Quan was the foundation of the Jiang family, and they would never allow outsiders to get involved.
"Jiang Hao, don't spit on others."
Jiang Liang was young and energetic. He couldn't see Shen Changqing being slandered, so he immediately stood up and said, "Brother Changqing is practicing at Taixu Sword Temple, so there is no need to learn martial arts."
Practice? !
Each of these men is extremely strong. They stand there like walls, giving people a sense of oppression.
After hearing Jiang Liang's words, Jiang Ba immediately glanced at Shen Changqing with cold eyes, and his voice was as dull as thunder: "Changqing went to practice?"
This is not a shameful thing. Shen Changqing looked calm and said truthfully: "Not bad."
"It's your ability to get spiritual stones."
Jiang Ba was quite impressed by this foreigner. He shook his head and said, "But let me tell you, instead of hoping for those illusory things, you might as well exchange it for the Gangxing Fist. At least I can guarantee that you can learn a few moves instead of just being useless like you are now."
"That's right, practicing is a life-threatening thing. Changqing, you have that life too." Jiang Hao was obviously a little bit sour, but he didn't think Shen Changqing could succeed, he was just jealous that the other party could get spiritual stones to practice.
Jiang Ba no longer looked at Shen Changqing, but said to Jiang Bo: "Lao Wu, I don't want Jiang's martial arts to be spread to other people."
If Shen Changqing fails in cultivation, he will definitely still have to practice martial arts. If the other party can get the spirit stone, it is not impossible for him to take a look, but if he can't get it, he will definitely not allow it to be spread!
After saying that, he ordered the people behind him to take a cloth bag and handed it to Uncle Jiang, "This is your family's qi and blood medicine for this month. Keep it."
After doing all this, Jiang Ba and his party left.
"Changqing, don't be influenced by others and practice hard." Uncle Jiang was worried that the words of Jiang Ba and others would affect Shen Changqing's mentality, so he quickly comforted him.
Shen Changqing smiled and didn't take it seriously.
Jiang Liang has always been curious about life in the inner city, and now he also asked: "Brother Changqing, what is life in the inner city like?"
Uncle Jiang also looked at Shen Changqing, wanting to know what his life became after being found by the Shen family.
Shen Changqing did not hide anything, and told about his transactions with Shen Zhengfeng and his wife and even his marriage to the Li family.
As soon as he finished speaking, Jiang Liang was filled with indignation and said, "No wonder the Shen family doesn't allow us to tell others about your origins and whereabouts. It turns out that we had such a plan for a long time."
Shen Changqing was silent.
Uncle Jiang sighed and said, "Although my yard is small, I can still make room for one more person at any time."
Jiang Liang also calmed down. He patted his chest and said, "Brother Changqing, even if you fail in cultivation, I can still protect you."
Snap.
